name: restart
description: Restart safety. S1 starts at n1, markers are delivered to n2 (which records) but deliberately never reach n3 and n3 never closes, so n1 and n2 are left mid-round. The harness then simulates a process restart (epoch bump + RecoverAbortedRounds). Requirements verified in tests/restart_test.go rather than only here: the old round is aborted state_conflict/round_stale_after_restart, stale markers from epoch 1 are rejected, and a completed verification refuses to stitch states across the restart. This fixture keeps the round incomplete and declares it so.

steps.note: n1 records local 50 and queues markers
t1 crosses n1->n2 while the round is open
n2 records local 30 on S1 marker, closes n1->n2 empty; queues its markers
t1 delivered post-marker: credited d 30->38, not captured
n1 closes inbound n2->n1; n1 still WAITING on n3 and n2 still waiting on n3 -> round intentionally left recording
